introHtml: PL buttons, stickers, and patches offer a reliable, cost-effective way to promote your brand at events or in the workplace. Whether you need 1-inch lapel pins for a trade show or 3-inch buttons for a company picnic, PL products deliver consistent quality. Choose from square buttons with pin backs, plantable ribbon pins, or button cards for easy distribution. These items are ideal for safety managers distributing hazard stickers or HR directors creating employee recognition badges. Durable and customizable, PL branded promotional products help your message stick.
